title: Prevent accidental CLI updates and verify Smithery publication reliably.
changes: Treat remcp update --help and remcp --help as side-effect-free help requests. A help flag must never install packages, restart the agent, or change pairing.
Retry only transient Smithery public catalog HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 and temporary transport failures after an already successful publish, with bounded backoff.
Continue requiring an exact public Smithery catalog entry and canonical connection URL. Do not accept missing results, authentication errors, or exhausted retries as a successful publication.
Retry transient 409/503 release-coordination responses from the official version endpoint during Windows bootstrap, without accepting an unverified package version.
Retain and reverify all safe Linux updater and npm prefix fixes from v0.2.203.
